mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in the past month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the federal funds rate increased by more than 0.5% in the past month.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points in the past month indicates weakening labor market conditions, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the unemployment rate increased by more than 0.3 percentage points in the past month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings expectations are revised downwards.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 50% of the instances where real GDP declined over two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in the past two months signals a strengthening supply side of the economy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings expectations improve.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances where industrial production increased by more than 1% in the past two months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4.5% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) is rising faster than 0.3% per month, it indicates an inflationary environment with tight monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL increase > 0.3% per month
regime_hint: inflationary environment with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the federal funds rate is above 4.5% and CPI is rising faster than 0.3% per month.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in the past month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2 percentage points, it signals a strengthening labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increase > 200k in 1 month and UNRATE decrease > 0.2pp
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 60% of the instances where nonfarm payrolls increased by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate decreased by more than 0.2 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% in the past two months signals a weakening demand in the housing market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the broader economic demand weakens.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 50% of the instances where housing starts declined by more than 5% in the past two months.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) grows by more than 2% in the past quarter and industrial production (INDPRO) increases by more than 1% in the past two months, it signals a robust supply side of the economy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increase > 2% in 1 quarter and INDPRO increase > 1% in 2 months
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances where real GDP grew by more than 2% in the past quarter and industrial production increased by more than 1% in the past two months.
